_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Live NI acquisition now keeps mirrored diagnostic checkpoints every five seconds,
using a background writer with one replaceable pending snapshot. A process crash
can no longer discard all acquisition stall and read-error timing. Checkpoints
are atomic, incomplete diagnostics; closed recording summaries remain authoritative.

Both branches passed 70 focused checks, clean layout audits and GUI smoke tests.
The change does not alter firmware, controller behavior, calibration or NI time.
Each release retains its branch-specific qualified firmware and menu.

Startup deflation tracking and pulse-dependent Smart Const landing remain measured
controller issues. Weak-pulse MAP, low-pressure pulse preservation, cross-cuff SysID
and fleet qualification remain open. The active original270 simulator experiment
keeps its installed version until collection ends and the live idle gate passes.
